_sobre: Format example of the light-trail teaser, with no brand: 16:9, two slow fragments (a cropped photo with no text over it, a number that counts), the phone reveal, and the closing with the logo alone opening in a circle from the light (fecho.abre: circulo). The screenshot in example-photo/ comes from the sample page, captured by example-photo/capture-guide.cjs. Greys, placeholder texts, photo and screen and the placeholder logo stand for the person's brand and content: swap them. Render: node scripts/example-fonts.mjs <output>/project && node templates/light-trail-teaser/render.mjs templates/light-trail-teaser/example-photo.json <output> 16x9
